reviews.t: Works with dollar shave club blades
reviews.x: I’ve been a subscriber to dollar shave club for years and I’m always dropping my handles and breaking them. I tend to forget to add an additional handle to my scheduled orders so it really comes in handy that these are available. Dollar shave club handles are cheaper if you remember to order them but this is far more convenient if you need it in a couple days rather than 1-2 months. It’s sturdy and works great, I will inevitability purchase these again and again and highly recommend them.

reviews.t: This works with dollar shave club blades
reviews.x: If the connection point on this handle looks like the one on your Dollar Shave Club handle, buy it. The reviews weren’t clear on whether or not it would fit, but it does, and it’s better than the handles you get from Dollar Shave Club. Incredibly sturdy and a better shave.
Love this set.  The BEST shaving system hands down.  With this handle I've got something I can take traveling.  This thing feels like quality and holds up very well.
I have a heavy beard that feels like wire. Blades do an excellent job. Blades remain sharp for longer than i expected. Great value

reviews.t: Just as good as name brands.
reviews.x: Nice razor handle.  Cheaper than name brands and just as good.

reviews.t: These are awesome! It's ridiculous how much razor blades cost at ...
reviews.x: These are awesome! It's ridiculous how much razor blades cost at the store. I was buying the cheapest ones I could find and using them to the point of discomfort. These are a Godsend. I've been using the same one for quite some time and it still does a great job with no discomfort. For the male take on these, my picky husband even thinks they're great because they work so well on the more coarse and dense beard hair. I'll def get more of these next time!

I bought this to replace a dollar shave club handle that breaks often.  These worked just fine with their blades.  However I had trim off with a nipper about half of the plastic piece that pushes the blade off to eject.  It was restricting the blade from flexing.  So not 100% compatibility out of the box, but small modification and worked fine.  Seems like a much better made handle so far

reviews.t: Alternative to Dollar Shave club executive razor!

Dollar Shave Club discontinued the executive razor and the blades would not fit unless you bought one of their new versions. They offered poor customer service and fortunately for me I was able to to see this product online and am very satisfied.

claims.text: Customers frequently report that the handle is compatible with Dollar Shave Club razor blades and cartridges.
Many reviewers say the handle is stronger and more durable than the original Dollar Shave Club handles, which they often broke by dropping.
Several customers describe it as a good value or cheaper alternative to name-brand handles.
A few reviewers note minor fit issues, such as needing to trim plastic for full blade compatibility or a shave that isn't as smooth as advertised.
Some customers mention compatibility with Dorco blades as well as Dollar Shave Club blades.
